entry: New: Hold the Line, a run mode you switch on in the Game options before round 1. Keep at least two of the three regions out of the critical tier for as many rounds as you can while escalation events (a heat dome, a wildfire season and more, in a fixed order) raise the background warming and lower how much protection can hold. A finished run earns a title from Ice Cube up to Cryosphere Guardian, shows which of three fixed AI stewards (Cautious Kai, Rash Rasmus, Balanced Bea) you beat, and is saved as a Field Notes entry on this device. Field Notes charts your runs and overlays any two on one graph, or a run against what would have happened with no action. Settings gained a temperature unit (Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin), a blindfold mode that hides the graphs, different dash patterns and end markers for each region's line, and a high-contrast readable-font theme.

New: a Copy result button under the Highlights recap copies a one-line result (rounds played, regions that tipped, degrees saved against no action) to share. Earned achievements now have a Share button, and a Credits link sits at the bottom of the page (in the Help menu on Desktop).

New in Thaw: resource convoys that move funds between Regions A, B and C for a 20% transport tax, a perfect-balance bonus when all three melting regions finish within 1 degree of each other, an Ice Age medal for long runs without a tipping event, a "phew" note when your last move pulls a region back from going critical, an "Explain this number" breakdown of the warming rate, an acceleration sparkline, a three-line highlights recap you can copy, spoken round summaries and graph descriptions for screen readers, and a Lite mode in Settings that drops blur and background animation.

New Desktop layout for wide windows: a full-window view with the round, funds and the temperatures of Regions A, B and C as chips across the top, Region A's status and graph beside the Region B and C comparison, and your investments with Advance Round pinned at the top of a column on the right. The Climate Scientist chart is one of three icons in the top bar; the archive and scientist's log, Region D, the long-game and framing options, community comparison and the rest are windows opened from the Menu (Esc), and key moments pop up as notifications. Pick it from the opening screen; your save carries over and the Classic layout is unchanged.

Long game mode: an opt-in setting, chosen before the first round, that stretches the whole trajectory to roughly two and a half times as many rounds (warming, feedback and restoration at 40% speed, Output pays 60%) for players who want the full long-run picture (G9).
Climate Scientist panel: a real chart of NOAA's actual global atmospheric methane growth data, 1984-2025, shown alongside the in-game graph (G7).
Tipping cascade: when Region A or B tips into melt there is a small chance the shock spreads to the next region as a one-time 0.5 degree bump (G5).
Permafrost carbon bank: regions that hold warming under 1.2x with Preservation in place bank a credit each round; 10 credits fund a one-time +120 grant to any of Regions A-C (G3).
"Four regions, one story": Monitoring investment in Regions A-C now feeds a shared research station whose story unfolds in chapters, with Region D as the control every paper cites (G17).
Climate archive: a panel of each region's best-ever degrees saved, furthest round and peak dampening, kept on this device across every session (G23).
Framing toggle: switch the same numbers between "my region's choices" and a global aggregate of Regions A-C (G29).
Thaw forecast mini-game: optionally lock in a guess of Region A's temperature before each round and earn a Forecaster title for accuracy (G27).
Permafrost restoration: once investment has held a melting region's feedback loop down for 3 rounds in a row, each Preservation unit starts pulling melt-driven warming back (G15).
Optional starting policy stance for Region A: pick Growth-led, Balanced or Mitigation-led before round 1 to trade a little starting funds against a small permanent dampening head start (G13).
Region rescue: once per region, when it tips into the critical tier, you can pay 200 funds for an emergency rescue that sharply dampens the feedback loop for 5 rounds (G21).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
Fixed a region's strategy-label text box overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.
The warming-rate info toggle now states a concrete calibration (roughly 50 real-world years per round, from NOAA's warming rate) instead of a vague "several years" disclaimer.

Fixed a performance bug where long sessions could make Advance Round take multiple seconds and climbing, caused by how the (intentionally worst-case) Region D reinvested its own growing income each round.
Fixed a display bug where the What's New panel showed as an empty box before its first open and never visually closed again once opened once.
G11: a new Community Comparison panel shows how your average warming-acceleration factor stacks up against everyone else's, once enough players have saved to compare against.
Z6: the personal-best label's "just improved" badge flash moved into the new shared shared/personal-best.css (also used by Canopy and Tide) instead of a per-game copy of the same rule.

Round-2 polish: temperature trend arrows, a stability streak counter, a scientist's log of key moments, a labelled melt-threshold line, warning icons on critical status, preset purchase previews, pre-emptive-investment praise, and a per-region personal best.
Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the tipping/dampening flashes are already redundantly coded with text, no change needed.

Achievements system added (18 achievements) plus the G1-G20 improvement pass: richer secondary-region readouts, a best-region comparison, preset strategies, a worst-case Region D, and a per-browser personal best.
Added a skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Full visual redesign: starfield/space-themed backdrop, glass panels, icon labels and count chips.
Integrated the shared save widget and fixed load_state() crashing outright on missing save fields.
Pass 3 balance fix: the intervention lever now gives an immediate, legible efficacy readout instead of a silent number with no felt effect pre-melt.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world permafrost sources; Pass 2 added a multi-region side-by-side comparison.
Iteration pass: a tipping-point screen flash and an alarming melt state, so the feedback loop's onset lands as a distinct moment.

All 7 core milestones shipped: background trajectory + core loop, permafrost melt + methane feedback, intervention measures, visible acceleration, hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
